claims.text: Reviewers overwhelmingly describe the stink bombs as extremely foul-smelling and effective at clearing rooms or disrupting people.
Many customers use them as pranks at work, school, or public places, often with enthusiastic results.
A few reviewers note the smell does not last very long and requires multiple vials to sustain the effect.
One reviewer reports that many vials were blanks and barely smelled, leading them not to recommend the product.
Customers appreciate the quantity of vials and fast shipping.
